description: The J28DK2 table contains demographic and mortality data for patients in a study. It includes subject identifiers (SJID), gender (GEND), date of birth (DOB), and multiple date of death records (DOD, DOD_HOSP, DOD_SSN) from different sources. The EXP_FLG column indicates whether a patient belongs to an experimental or control group. The primary key is RWID, a unique row identifier.

columns.name: RWID
columns.description: A unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: SJID
columns.description: Subject ID, likely a unique identifier assigned to each patient in the study.

columns.name: GEND
columns.description: Patient's gender, recorded as either 'M' (male) or 'F' (female).

columns.name: DOB
columns.description: Patient's date of birth, recorded in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: DOD
columns.description: Patient's date of death, recorded in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: Patient's date of death, recorded by the hospital in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: Patient's date of death, recorded by the Social Security Administration in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: EXP_FLG
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether the patient is part of an experimental group (1) or a control group (0).

description: Table VMW9F2 contains information about patient movement and location within the hospital system, including ward and care unit transitions during hospital admissions and ICU stays. It includes identifiers for subjects (patients), hospital admissions, and ICU stays, along with timestamps indicating entry and exit times for each location. The table also records the length of stay (LOS) associated with each movement event and the source database where the data originated. This table is useful for tracking patient flow and analyzing length of stay in different units.

columns.name: RWID
columns.description: A unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: SJID
columns.description: A subject identifier, likely a unique identifier for each patient.

columns.name: HADMID
columns.description: Hospital Admission Identifier, a unique identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUID
columns.description: Intensive Care Unit (ICU) Identifier, a unique identifier for each ICU stay.

columns.name: DB_SRC
columns.description: Source database for the record. Values may indicate a specific database or a combination (e.g., 'both').

columns.name: EVT_TP
columns.description: Event type associated with the record (e.g., 'admit', 'transfer').

columns.name: PREV_CUNIT
columns.description: Previous Care Unit. Indicates the type of care unit the patient was in prior to the current event (e.g., 'CCU', 'TSICU').

columns.name: CUR_CUNIT
columns.description: Current Care Unit. Indicates the type of care unit the patient is currently in (e.g., 'NWARD', 'CCU').

columns.name: PREV_WDID
columns.description: Previous Ward ID. Numerical identifier for the ward the patient was previously in.

columns.name: CURR_WARDID
columns.description: Current Ward ID. Numerical identifier for the ward the patient is currently in.

columns.name: INTM
columns.description: The 'in' timestamp, indicating when the event started or when the patient entered a specific location.

columns.name: OUTTM
columns.description: The 'out' timestamp, indicating when the event ended or when the patient left a specific location.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: Length of Stay. Duration of stay, calculated as the difference between the 'out' timestamp (OUTTM) and the 'in' timestamp (INTM), likely measured in days.

description: Table A9S71 contains information on medical procedures and services (identified by CPT codes) performed during hospital admissions. It includes details such as the patient (SJID), hospital admission (HADMID), cost center (CST_CTR), date of service (CHARTDT), and specific CPT code information (CPT_CD, CPT_NO, CPT_SUFF, SECHEAD, SUBSECHEAD, DESC). The table links procedures to specific patient encounters and provides context for cost analysis and service tracking within the hospital.

columns.name: RWID
columns.description: A unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: SJID
columns.description: Subject ID: A numerical identifier assigned to each patient in the study.

columns.name: HADMID
columns.description: Hospital Admission ID: A numerical identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: CST_CTR
columns.description: Cost Center: The department or unit within the hospital where the cost was incurred, such as 'ICU' or 'Resp'.

columns.name: CHARTDT
columns.description: Charting Date: The date when the procedure or observation was recorded, formatted as DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: CPT_CD
columns.description: CPT Code: Numeric code representing a medical procedure or service.

columns.name: CPT_NO
columns.description: CPT Number: The numeric identifier associated with a Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) code.

columns.name: CPT_SUFF
columns.description: CPT Suffix: Alphanumeric suffix providing additional detail for a CPT code. Likely a modifier with a value of 'T'.

columns.name: TIX_ID_SEQ
columns.description: Tax ID Sequence: A numerical identifier associated with a Tax ID.

columns.name: SECHEAD
columns.description: Section Heading: The primary category or section of the CPT code, describing the general type of service provided (e.g., 'Evaluation and management', 'Anesthesia', 'Surgery').

columns.name: SUBSECHEAD
columns.description: Sub-Section Heading: A more specific categorization of the CPT code, providing further detail about the nature of the service (e.g., 'Hospital inpatient services', 'Conscious sedation (deleted codes)').

columns.name: DESC
columns.description: Description: Detailed description of procedure associated with the CPT code, for example, ventilator management in the Intensive Care Unit.

description: Table 2NCH8 provides a comprehensive dictionary of ITEMIDs used within the clinical database. It maps each ITEMID to a descriptive label, abbreviation, source database, linked table, category, unit of measurement, parameter type, and a (currently unpopulated) concept identifier. This table facilitates understanding and interpretation of clinical data by providing context for each measurement or concept recorded in the system.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: ITEMID
columns.description: The unique identifier for a given clinical measurement, such as heart rate, blood pressure, or medication. Corresponds to a specific concept within the database.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: A descriptive label associated with the ITEMID, providing a human-readable description of the clinical measurement or concept (e.g., drug name, lab test name, etc.).

columns.name: ABBREVIATION
columns.description: An abbreviated form or acronym for the LABEL, providing a shorter representation of the clinical measurement or concept.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: Indicates the database source from which the data originated, such as 'carevue' or 'metavision'.

columns.name: LINKSTO
columns.description: Specifies the table to which this item is linked, such as 'chartevents', 'inputevents_mv' or 'procedureevents_mv'.

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.description: Categorizes the ITEMID into broader groups, such as 'Urine' or '4-Procedures'.

columns.name: UNITNAME
columns.description: The unit of measurement associated with the ITEMID, such as 'mL/m2' or 'grams'.

columns.name: PARAM_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the data type or parameter type associated with the ITEMID, such as 'Numeric' or 'Solution'.

columns.name: CONCEPTID
columns.description: Maps the ITEMID to a standardized concept identifier from a clinical ontology, which is not populated in this dataset.
